genius.notes: BCP's FCA registration and sandbox participation establish UK regulatory context only. No public GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, or registered foreign-issuer exception was located for BCP Technologies Ltd or tGBP. The reviewed product materials also did not establish that tGBP is offered to U.S. persons, so the payment-stablecoin applicability call is product-based rather than a finding of U.S. distribution. The transparency hub publishes a monthly independent accountants report series through August 2026; the opened Andersen August report is agreed-upon procedures, not an audit or review assurance engagement. DASP not-yet-restricted records the pre-effective GENIUS framework and does not establish U.S. distribution or permission under other laws.
